title: emergency.py: Timestamp value 0 incorrectly treated as falsy
description:
Line 122 uses body.get("t") or body.get("ts") to select the timestamp field. Unix timestamp 0 (1970-01-01 00:00:00 UTC) is a valid value but is falsy in Python. If t=0 is provided, the expression falls back to the ts field. If ts is absent, the request is rejected with BAD_REQUEST even though t=0 is explicitly allowed by the validation on line 137 (timestamp < 0 is rejected, not timestamp <= 0). If ts is present with a different value, the wrong timestamp is used. Fix: use body.get("t") if body.get("t") is not None else body.get("ts") or similar explicit None check.

File: python/src/lichen/coap/resources/emergency.py
Line: 122
close_reason: Duplicate of vtw7. Bug already fixed - code now uses 'in body' check instead of falsy-prone 'or' pattern.
